verses.text: Thank the LORD because he’s good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the God of gods. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the Lord of lords. His faithful love lasts forever.
the one who alone does great wonders. His faithful love lasts forever.
who made the heavens with understanding. His faithful love lasts forever.
who spread the earth out above the waters. His faithful love lasts forever.
who made the great lights. His faithful love lasts forever.
the sun to rule the day. His faithful love lasts forever.
the moon and stars to rule the night. His faithful love lasts forever.
who struck down Egypt’s firstborn. His faithful love lasts forever.
and brought Israel out from among the Egyptians. His faithful love lasts forever.
with a strong hand and an arm stretched out. His faithful love lasts forever.
who split the Red Sea in two. His faithful love lasts forever.
and led Israel right through the middle. His faithful love lasts forever.
but swept Pharaoh and his army away in the Red Sea. His faithful love lasts forever.
who led his people through the wilderness. His faithful love lasts forever.
who brought down great kings. His faithful love lasts forever.
and killed mighty kings. His faithful love lasts forever.
Sihon, king of the Amorites. His faithful love lasts forever.
and Og, king of Bashan. His faithful love lasts forever.
who gave their land as an inheritance. His faithful love lasts forever.
an inheritance for Israel, his servant. His faithful love lasts forever.
who remembered us when we were brought low. His faithful love lasts forever.
and rescued us from our enemies. His faithful love lasts forever.
who feeds every living creature. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the God of heaven. His faithful love lasts forever.
